protocol.baseline_adapter: Seeds, measured-frame evidence fields and worker timing-only wrapper; exact patch baseline-observability.patch. Recorder is a read-only observer.
protocol.failure_policy: All scheduled algorithm failures/timeouts stay in the denominator. Infrastructure attempts and retries are disclosed separately; successful-only latency is explicitly labeled.
protocol.pairing: Same seed, map, 3 starts, native 3D sensor/noise, dynamics and resources; serialize all Gazebo runs.
protocol.ablation_policy: Offline frozen-source mutants only, with patches and manifests. Deployment retains one combined entry.
